📣 275,000 people have just handed a petition to Downing Street demanding the tax-free personal allowance be unfrozen.

It's been stuck at £12,570 since 2021 and is set to stay there until 2031. Andy Burnham says the issue is "lodged in my mind" - but he's made no commitment ahead of the Budget on 28 October.

Warm words cost nothing. Let's see if he acts. 👇
